tips.text: Keep your free Broken War out of War; its pre-installed Catalyst does not carry over, and replacing it can take years.
Buy the War Hilt and Blades from Simaris; farming the 0.5% Sentient drops is obsolete.
Stay permanently marked and play whatever you were going to play; farming Stalker deliberately burns people out.
Play missions long enough for his window to open; a 1-minute Capture can end before he rolls.
Squad up with other marked players; four marked players raise the spawn chance from 2% to 3.5%.
Bring Jade in the squad; Stalker says "Never", drops his loot and leaves, so each spawn is free.
Kill the Hyena Pack on Psamathe, Neptune for several marks at once, or The Sergeant on Iliad, Phobos for the fastest single mark.
Pool Stalker Beacons with squadmates and use one per mission to spread the cost.
Kill Stalker before he flees at 10% health or his target goes down, or you may get nothing.
Treat the second copy as a background grind: dozens of dry kills are normal and timelines run to years.
